title: Tech Note: Access Files in 4D using 4D Mobile
author: Xiang Liu, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D Mobile and its embedded Wakanda server were discontinued; the Wakanda-specific File/BLOB JavaScript API described here no longer exists in current 4D. File transfer to web/mobile clients today is handled through ORDA REST APIs, standard HTTP file endpoints, or 4D's own web server BLOB handling.
